notes.title: Preparing for global update and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Dear friends,
We hasten to inform you that we are actively working on the project. A major update with the addition of infinite mode is waiting for you in the near future!
In the meantime, we have released a patch with bug fixes and bug fixes, in which we have fixed the following:
Fixed a bug when trying to connect to a random lobby
Fixed a bug that caused infinite loading when exiting a level
Fixed a bug when trying to connect to a friend through the Join button in the profile
Fixed an issue when trying to connect to a friend through the Friends panel interface
Fixed an error when trying to invite a friend by pressing the + button in the main menu 
Fixed an error when trying to invite a friend through the Friends panel interface
Fixed a bug where other players' skins were not displayed in the main menu
Fixed a bug that allowed you to buy weapons even if you didn't have enough money for them
Fixed a bug where the visual effect of a flamethrower remains when it is destroyed
Fixed a bug where not all buildings were destroyed during a boss battle
Fixed incorrect deceleration characteristics of some buildings
Fixed a bug where the Join Random Room button became inactive
Fixed visual display of destruction effects

notes.title: Game release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039625/c56d02ec9ba892f9b4a174ef129a02d1b397b874.jpg[/img]
Survivors, the day has come when you can finally enter the world of Dead Zone Defense.
We are happy to present you the release version of the project, which is already available in the store!

Here is the list of what is already waiting for you in the game:

More than 20 weapons
7 unique locations
3 difficulty levels with changing mechanics
7 unique bosses
More than 20 different skills
More than 50 weapon skins
More than 15 character skins
Over 30 types of buildings and their modifications
HUNDREDS of enemies you can tear apart.
Colorful destructibility system

Also, we are very carefully watching out for possible bugs and errors that you may find.
If you encounter something like this, write in the created discussion, and we will answer you and fix it as soon as possible!
Moreover, if you have any ideas on how to improve the game, just as boldly write in the discussion and describe your idea.
All the best ideas will be realized for sure!

In addition to all this, in the near future you will be waiting for a major FULL FREE update, which will add to the game:
Infinite Mode
Stats boosters
Leaderboard
Adding new networking features
Lore expansion
Dialog system
Minor tweaks

Thank you for your interest in the project!
If you are still in the post-apocalyptic wastelands, then stop delaying!
Go on an adventure now together with hundreds of other players from all over the world!

notes.title: Game release on July 29th!
notes.notes:
Survivors!

We are glad to inform you that already on July 29 our project is released!
You are waiting for a very fun and dynamic game, also filled with tactics!
We are sure that you will enjoy and appreciate what we have done.
Tense battles with hordes of enemies, a huge arsenal of buildings and weapons, unique bosses - everything that would not let you get bored!

Stock up on snacks and sodas, because you and your friends are sure to be sucked in by the gameplay we've created for you!
Thank you for your attention to our game, we are sure you will enjoy it!
We'll meet you on July 29th on the vastness of the destroyed locations of the post-apocalypse!

notes.title: We're getting ready for the release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039625/c56d02ec9ba892f9b4a174ef129a02d1b397b874.jpg[/img]
Dear friends, we are glad to inform you that our game is going to be released soon!

Our game will offer you a mix of tower defense, top-down shooter and strategy.
A huge arsenal of buildings, a variety of weapons, an extensive skill system and a lot of skins - we are sure you will be able to appreciate the work we have done when our project is released.
No pre-designed places for defense - all locations are created so that everyone can come up with their own strategy.
The variety of locations and unique bosses with their own mechanics will challenge you.
You may ask, what exactly will be waiting for you in the release version?
We know you're already excited for the release, so here's the list

Over 20 different weapons
7 Unique Locations
3 Difficulty Levels with changing mechanics
7 Unique bosses
Over 20 different skills
Over 50 weapon skins
More than 15 character skins
More than 30 types of buildings and their modifications
HUNDREDS of enemies that you can tear apart. BOOKWORK.
Colorful destructibility system
Tight optimization

Agree, very cool!
Thank you for being interested in our project!
Add to your wishlist now to be among the first to fight for the right to stay alive!
That's all for today, in the next news you will learn about our work with the multiplayer part and a brand new mode.
